text_block_list.text: Right on the eve of the second "Dream Fest"—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, I heard this 'Dream Fest'
is gathering the absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's that!
Is this different from the previous All-Star!?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying it's not just a regular festival?
That's... a "race"!
Sounds super fun! Let's go watch it~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Haa!? She's obviously the strongest!
Just look at her race record, it's totally clear—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Results matter, sure, but what really counts is whether you win in spectacular fashion!
It's that electrifying impact that made me...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
M-My favorite is great too...!
Her... late kick is just
so insanely cool, and...――

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, look at them all fired up!
Then again, how could you not get passionate about this?

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"When people say 'the strongest'...
Naturally, they mean their favorite!"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I definitely... want my fave to win!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Because she's strong... cool... and puts on
the greatest races!"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—<nickname>!
You've gotta win, okay~~?!

――The passion for racing had surged far beyond the first "Dream Fest"...
And it was undoubtedly reaching the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—<nickname>-chan,
were you feeling fired up?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: All the other runners were radiating pure ambition, too.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, it will be a race that meets the fans' passion...
No, it will surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Say, St Lite-san.
It seems I partly have you egging me on to thank for this.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Oh, my apologies.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: "Such immense expectations from the fans, and the burning passion of the Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite a long time, after all.
I was completely overwhelmed by the atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: "...'The strongest' was your epithet as well, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
However, that was a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: I'll leave it to those girls, who are living in the present.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, <chrname>.
Please, allow me to see it.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The very essence of Umamusume racing.
—Its "Pride"!
